title: WPMS/430/2020 of GURNAM SINGH Vs DISTRICT MAGISTRATE DEHRADUN

paras.text:
WPMS No. 430 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Mehboob Rahi, learned counsel for the
petitioner and Mr. Suyah Pant, learned Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand.
According to the petitioner, he needs a 'Character
Certificate' for participating in the bidding process for
award of a contract. He had applied for 'Character
Certificate' before the Competent Authority on
22.11.2019. Grievance of the petitioner is that no
decision has been taken on the said application so far.
Learned counsel for the State submits that
petitioner is a 'Bad Character' and he was prosecuted for
the offences punishable under Section 25 Arms Act and
Section 307 of I.P.C., therefore, he cannot be given a
'Character Certificate'.
The submission made by learned counsel for the
State is disputed by learned counsel for the petitioner and
he submits that petitioner has been acquitted of the
charge of offences punishable under the aforesaid
Sections.
Be that as it may, since petitioner's application for
'Character Certificate' is pending before the Competent
Authority, therefore, writ petition is disposed of with a
direction to the Competent Authority to consider
petitioner's application and pass appropriate order, in
accordance with law, within two months from the date of
production of certified copy of this order.
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
19.02.2020 Aswal
